what_this_is: The whole Dance Atlas library, readable by a website or by any agent. Start here, read the rules, then index.json, then one file per dance.
rules: Everything here was gathered and written by a machine from public sources and checked against them: quotes, links, timestamps. It has not been reviewed by a person, cleared for rights or tested on learners. Say so when you use it.
A dance with teaching_withheld is sacred or restricted. Tell its story with care. Never teach it, and never rebuild its steps from other sources.
Never invent steps, counts, origins, credits or rankings. What is missing is missing: readiness.missing names it.
What a machine saw in a video is a candidate, not a verified fact (verification: model_candidate). A performance never supplies counts.

Teach from bdf_teaching_system.json: dna is the default behaviour, adjustments and mentor.feelings answer a difficulty or a feeling, learner_model is what to keep in mind about one person. It is evidence, not a verdict. mentor_brief.json holds the same in a few thousand words, sized to sit beside one dance in a conversation.
Atlas (traditions) and Viral (challenges and dance culture) are separate collections.
Videos, pictures and music are linked, never copied. A link is not a licence to reuse.

The state active_ready means the machine has gathered everything a teaching service needs for that dance. Activation still needs human review, music rights and platform tests (ACTIVE_PROFILE_STANDARD.md).

files.holds: where to start: every file, its contract and the standing rules
every dance in a few fields, with the address and fingerprint of its own file
how to teach anyone to dance: the teaching DNA, how to adjust, the mentor, what to remember about a learner, with the evidence
the starting line: which dances have everything a teaching service needs
how the machine is doing: the last nights, the pace, what holds pages back
the words of the website's newer screens
the viral dance challenges: who made each, when, the song and the sources; in order of date, not a ranking
the mentor's reading list: every research topic and where it stands, what was found with its checked quotes, the papers of the open search
the mentor in a few thousand words, sized for an agent's context: the default behaviour, the six moments, what to do when it is hard
entries that were removed or merged, and where they went
draft scripts per dance (a presentation asset, not proof of readiness)
the older single file the website loaded before the index; kept for compatibility
the older single file of deep profiles; the same content is in d/<slug>.json

sections.card: identity and the short story: names, places, era, family, hero video, pictures, sources
sections.profile: the deep profile of a published dance: story sections, music, movement, connections, footage, checked claims
sections.readiness: the dance against the starting line: how many of the items it has and which are missing
sections.lessons: lessons the machine studied: parts with their time, steps with counts, cues, common mistakes, what works
sections.performances: what the machine saw in the dance's own performance video
sections.episodes: the state of the draft scripts and where they are
sections.teaching_withheld: present on a sacred or restricted dance: why nothing is taught

dance_file.changes: A dance file carries no clock. Compare the fingerprint in index.json (fp) with the one you kept and fetch only what moved.

how_to_use: dna: what the teacher does by default; a rule appears only where two or more kinds of evidence agree, and evidence_kinds says how strong it is
adjustments: when a learner says something is hard, what teachers offer for it and what the research adds

mentor.moments: what teachers say at the moments that decide whether a learner stays; mentor.creed: what they believe, sorted; mentor.feelings: when a learner shows a feeling, how teachers have answered it; mentor.voice: how they sound
learner_model: what to keep in mind about one learner over time, so that the teaching fits them better the longer they stay
practices, adaptations, science, papers: the evidence behind every line, each with a link to the video moment or the source

whole_library.copy: A dated copy of the whole repository is published every month: https://github.com/DANCEATLAS/crawler/releases
whole_library.note: Small enough to keep on a phone or to load into an agent that works without a connection.
